newsitem.title: USA: Clinton to meet congressional leaders Tuesday.
newsitem.headline: Clinton to meet congressional leaders Tuesday.

text.p: President Bill Clinton will meet the Republican and Democratic leaders of Congress on Tuesday to discuss the U.S. balanced budget agreement, among other issues, the White House said on Monday.

White House spokesman Barry Toiv told reporters that the meeting was scheduled for 1100 EST (1500 GMT) at the White House. He said the discussions would take place as part of a regular, periodic meeting with the bipartisan leadership.
Clinton and the legislators would discuss "the agenda for the next several weeks ... including, obviously, implementation of the budget agreement, but other issues as well," he said.
